$Comment: Head of the Table: the title the achievement harvest_feast_head_of_the_table pays once a player is Exalted with Martha. It shows beside a player's name in menus and leaderboards once they pick it. It names no keys: title.harvest_feast_head_of_the_table.name and .flavor name and describe it, and .display, whose {0} is the name, is where it sits around the name. Enabled false hides it everywhere without taking it from anybody who earned it.
